items.text:
This game is perfect for fans of Space Station 13 and Dwarf Fortress. Amazing simulations and depth of DF with all the intricacies and fine detail into every little thing in a very similar, interesting world as that of SS13, this hits all the parts for me. 0.14 seems to have improved a lot of the economy and bug issues since I've had a very engaging time with it at 14 hours in, spread over 2 days. 

Graphics aren't stunning of course, but if you're a fan of SS13 and DF, you'll appriciate all of its other aspects I'm sure. But nevertheless, the graphics do an admirable job at displaying all the dizzying depth of the game in a easily readable way, though it still does struggle sometimes in the readability area in extreme cases. The art style itself is perfect for the setting and the style it's going for. Graphics should improve towards 1.0 too.

Also what has great style is the writing! The writing is also very good and has the right amount of humor. It does a great job at painting the picture of the wider world of Ostranauts. The interesting story is told through  character creation, a few pop-ups in the early game and by the world itself in which every single item and piece of station or ship as its own description. You can also find additional lore dumps about specific subjects or flavor text about various files in locked PDA's which you can hack open.

It's hard, and you should very much head into this with the same attitude as you'd have first tackling SS13 or DF. You'll fail a bit, you'll struggle with all the dizzying mechanics that the game offers, you'll at least once vent your ship. But all through that the game will keep you engaged and eager to see the depths it offers. At the end of this learning, you'll find a rewarding gameplay loop as you strive towards improving your lot in life.

I've encountered no bugs to speak of (still some understandable jank & exploits, but nothing game breaking or distracting) and the game hasn't crashed once. Amazingly stable and put together at this early stage.

If you like SS13, DF or even Factorio (Never played, but it's a good guess), you'll find a new destitute, oppressive, and deliciously bleak life to dive head-first into in this fantastic game which is bound to only improve as we head towards launch next year.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏非常适合《太空站13》和《矮人要塞》的粉丝。惊人的模拟和《矮人要塞》的深度，将每一个小事物的所有复杂性和精细细节融入一个与《太空站13》非常相似、有趣的世界中，这完全符合我的所有期待。0.14版本似乎改善了很多经济系统和bug问题，因为我在14小时的游戏时间中（分散在两天里）获得了非常投入的体验。

画面当然不算惊艳，但如果你是《太空站13》和《矮人要塞》的粉丝，我相信你会欣赏它的其他所有方面。不过，画面在以一种易于阅读的方式展示游戏令人眼花缭乱的深度方面做得相当出色，尽管在极端情况下它在可读性方面有时仍然有些吃力。美术风格本身非常适合这个设定和它所追求的风格。画面应该也会朝着1.0版本不断改进。

同样具有出色风格的还有文本！文笔也非常好，幽默感恰到好处。它出色地描绘了《Ostranauts》更广阔世界的图景。有趣的故事通过角色创建、游戏早期的一些弹窗以及世界本身来讲述，其中每一件物品、每一个空间站或飞船部件都有自己的描述。你还可以在上锁的PDA中找到关于特定主题的额外背景故事，或者各种文件的趣味文本，这些PDA你可以黑入打开。

游戏很难，你应该带着初次接触《太空站13》或《矮人要塞》时的那种心态来玩。你会失败几次，你会被游戏提供的所有令人眼花缭乱的机制搞得焦头烂额，你至少会有一次把自己的飞船弄到泄气。但在这一切过程中，游戏会让你保持投入，渴望看到它所提供的深度。在学习阶段结束时，你会发现一个令人满足的游戏循环，因为你在努力改善自己的生活处境。

我没有遇到什么值得一提的bug（还有一些可以理解的粗糙之处和漏洞，但没有什么破坏游戏或让人分心的东西），游戏也一次都没有崩溃过。在这么早期的阶段，稳定性和完成度令人惊叹。

如果你喜欢《太空站13》、《矮人要塞》甚至《异星工厂》（没玩过，但这是个合理的猜测），你会在这款奇妙的游戏中找到一个全新的、贫困的、压抑的、令人愉悦的凄凉生活，一头扎进去。随着明年发售日的临近，这款游戏只会越来越好。
